profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Apple | AR/VR
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a passion for VR/AR. I am a communication-driven problem solver and enjoy being challenged in my work. I am a detail-oriented person who takes pride in delivering beautiful and functional software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineer for Personas on Apple Vision Pro

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Operated in a fast-paced developmental environment as a VR Software Engineer on Oculus System Apps.
• Led the development of a workflow to customize graphic assets of a 3D environment, a high-impact project for all Oculus users.
• Devised a workflow in Java (native Android) for customizing an Oculus home environment. Created a new UI view that displays and filters the textures and furniture models pulled from Oculus’ store that can be selected and applied.
• Used React VR to create a new section on the Oculus store for uploading textures and furniture models.
• Developed C++ code in Oculus’ frame refresh to catch applied customization and set the newly selected textures to render.
positions.insights: Java, User Interface Design and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Programmed Indoor Maps on iOS application in xcode using Storyboard and Swift
• Integrated data from REST APIs and used Alamofire, AnyCodeable, and ZipFoundation to download and integrate into the application
• Utilized Mapkit and designed Indoor Mapping Data Format classes to render GeoJson data
• Practiced Trunk Based Development and conventional Git commits
• Saved millions of dollars in Apple Database repairs/ damages with accurate color-coded by error database maps
positions.insights: Swift (Programming Language), REST APIs and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Spent time researching an affordable replacement for platinum as a catalyst for the cathode in lithium air batteries and fuel cells. Used Python to model complex atomic structures then used these structures to create algorithms to preform various optimizations that provide data useful to finding an effective replacement catalyst. I gained both research and programming experience through this work.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science and Arts - BSA
